title: Floor 1 overhead concept-art revision

scope.description: Parallel strict top-down concept-art revision covering the same 36 Floor 1 panels as the approved mixed-camera set. This remains an evidence-backed selection, not an exhaustive atlas or a claim that each panel is a separate named canon location.
scope.visualDirection: Root-approved target: direct-overhead top-down scene layouts across all panels. Thin interior wall sides and prop depth may remain, and some details are stylized for readability; no mathematical nadir projection is claimed.
scope.artBoundary: Parallel illustrative concept set only; no tile-ready or playable-map claims. Layouts, dimensions, connecting geometry, and details not directly described are inferred. No Book 2 locations or characters are in scope. The existing mixed-camera concept set remains intact.

projectionReview.assessment: Six sheets visually approved as top-down scene layouts; thin interior wall sides/prop depth and stylized readable details are acceptable. No mathematical projection verification.
projectionReview.claimPolicy: Describe as root-approved direct-overhead/top-down scene concepts with the stated visual allowances; do not claim perfect nadir, tile-ready assets, or playable maps.

projection: Direct overhead room and passage compositions visually reviewed by coordinator; minor prop edging, shading and stylized readable prop details may remain. No mathematical camera verification.

provenance.claim: Same36 Book1/Floor1 coverage IDs as original concepts; new source images only. Layouts, compositions, prop placement and monster interpretation are inferred; no gameplay integration or production asset readiness.

sheet.prompt: Draw a tactical BATTLEMAP in a TRUE VERTICAL CAMERA directly above at 90 degrees: bird's-eye ORTHOGRAPHIC FLOOR PLAN, like a richly colored architect's plan rendered in crisp pixel art. It must look like a flat board game map. ALL walls are ONLY flat thick navy stone strips viewed from their top, NONE have tall visible inside faces. ALL furniture is only horizontal TOP SURFACE SHAPES, with small shadows beneath. You cannot see the front or side of any cupboard, chair, vehicle or door. No perspective at all, no vanishing points, no tilted room, no front-facing showcase wall, no dollhouse view. All angles orthogonal aligned to image axes. Imagine the viewer is on the ceiling looking vertically down. Camera correctness is more important than ornament. Cobalt/slate dungeon masonry, grey square floor tiles, rich amber pools of light, detailed crisp GBA pixel textures. No text, letters, numbers, logos, UI, people or animals. Landscape 1536x1024 contact sheet, 3 COLUMNS x 2 ROWS, six independent square plan maps separated by 8px navy gutters and navy outer border. Six maps in strict rowmajor order. 1 street entrance stairwell: rectangular hole in paved street, railings drawn as narrow top-down rails around edges, stairs as flat regular parallel treads fading dark toward one end. 2 aquatic kuatin vestibule: square room with fish floor mosaics, round blue water pools either side, large double doors drawn as a THIN two-leaf plan symbol embedded in top wall strip, no upright door facade. 3 main entry tunnel: broad cross-shaped corridor with orthogonal branches, torch pools, round barrel tops and square crate tops. 4 fake guild alley: narrow irregular orthogonal alley footprint between building-roof strips, round trash-bin lids and crate tops, a SMALL flat blank purple sign slab viewed from above; no upright sign visible. 5 dozer alley trap: narrow junk-filled stone alley, TOP VIEW of bulldozer roof and engine panels, paired rectangular tank treads and a flat toothed blade extending at lower edge; no front grille visible. 6 real tutorial guild: rectangular room plan with flat wood desktop showing blank papers/quill, chair SEAT rectangles without backs, bench-top rectangles, flat blue rug and plain door threshold, wall shelves appear as narrow top-down strips. Make every map truly flat overhead.
